model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]  
**Justification:** The goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of neuronal somata, dendrites, and axons across the entire adult mouse brain—a large, lipid-rich tissue demanding strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration. iDISCO+ is an established, high-clearing-power organic solvent–based method optimized for whole adult mouse brains, enabling excellent tissue transparency and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust immunostaining: NeuN (pan-neuronal nuclear marker) for somata, MAP2 (dendritic marker) for dendrites, and DAPI as a nuclear counterstain to aid registration. Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 are highly compatible with iDISCO+, resistant to quenching, and ideal for multicolor light-sheet imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-NeuN (1:500) and anti-MAP2 (1:250) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), plus DAPI (1:1000), all diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer cleared brain into a glass imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE, seal to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-c-Fos primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary antibody, anti-NeuN primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires mapping behaviorally activated neurons at single-cell resolution across the entire adult mouse brain. Immediate early genes (IEGs) such as c-Fos are gold-standard markers for neuronal activation and provide target-specific labeling, while NeuN serves as a pan-neuronal nuclear marker to contextualize activated cells within the total neuronal population. iDISCO+ is selected because it is a well-established, high-clearing-power solvent-based method validated for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), enables deep antibody penetration, and preserves fine morphological detail necessary for 3D spatial mapping. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust, photostable Alexa Fluor dyes (647 and 488), which are fully compatible with iDISCO+. The method’s relatively fast processing time (days vs. weeks) and compatibility with light-sheet microscopy make it ideal for this application.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-c-Fos (e.g., rabbit polyclonal, 1:500) and anti-NeuN (e.g., mouse monoclonal, 1:500) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (same as 5.1).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (same as 6.1).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in imaging-compatible glass vial or chamber.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount directly in DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy using an RI-matched objective (RI ≈ 1.56).

**Chosen Method:** MACS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity preservation of long-range axonal continuity across a 15-mm spinal cord segment containing a mechanically fragile injury core. Organic solvent–based methods (e.g., iDISCO+, FDISCO, SOLID) induce tissue shrinkage and mechanical brittleness that led to fragmentation during electrophoresis in prior attempts. MACS is an aqueous, low-toxicity clearing method established for long CNS segments (T06 tier), preserves endogenous fluorescence (though not required here), and—critically—maintains tissue elasticity and spatial integrity without delipidation-induced fragility. It enables deep penetration of antibody-conjugated dyes while minimizing distortion. β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) robustly labels all axons (including regenerating fibers), while MAP2 marks dendritic arbors and neuronal somata, allowing discrimination between axonal tracts and local circuitry. Both are pan-neuronal structural markers compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes, which are fully stable in MACS and provide far-red/orange channels ideal for deep imaging with minimal scattering.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (performed post-fixation, pre-clearing)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-MAP2 (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle agitation)  
1.3 Wash with PBS + 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 × 24 hours, Temperature: RT, gentle agitation)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours, dark, gentle agitation)  
1.5 Wash with PBS + 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 × 24 hours, Temperature: RT, dark, gentle agitation)  

2 Dehydration (optional but recommended for refractive index transition)  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Rehydration (to prepare for aqueous clearing)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Optical Clearing with MACS  
4.1 Incubation with MACS-R0 (20 vol% MXDA, 15% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.40) (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours, gentle agitation)  
4.2 Incubation with MACS-R1 (40 vol% MXDA, 30% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.48) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle agitation)  
4.3 Incubation with MACS-R2 (40 vol% MXDA, 50% w/v sorbitol in PBS, RI ≈ 1.51) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle agitation)  

5 Refractive Index Matching and Storage  
5.1 Transfer sample to fresh MACS-R2 in glass vial (Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite storage or immediate imaging)  
5.2 Equilibrate at RT for ≥2 hours before light-sheet or confocal imaging to ensure uniform RI matching.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, MBP + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires distinguishing regenerating/rewiring axons (marked by pan-neuronal β-III Tubulin/TUJ1) from mature or preserved myelinated tracts (marked by myelin basic protein, MBP). iDISCO+ is established for long CNS segments (T06 tier), provides strong delipidation for deep antibody penetration into dense spinal cord tissue, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 568/647 conjugates. Although it quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on robust immunofluorescence with far-red dyes that survive organic solvent processing. iDISCO+ also enables high-resolution 3D imaging of long-range fiber trajectories across the injury epicenter with minimal background, critical for assessing fiber bypass, approach, or penetration.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (post-fixation, pre-clearing)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking buffer: 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-MBP (1:300) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.1% NaN₃, 5% DMSO, 3% normal donkey serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  
1.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS): 6 changes over 3 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) and donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)  
1.5 Wash with PBST: 6 changes over 3 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord autofluorescence)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.5%). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for final clearing and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours, protected from light)  

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE. Seal with coverslip using nail polish to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires simultaneous visualization of regenerating/remodeling axons (best labeled by pan-axonal marker β-III Tubulin/TUJ1) and mature/residual myelinated tracts (labeled by myelin basic protein, MBP). iDISCO+ is selected because it is established for long CNS segments (T06 tier), provides strong delipidation for deep antibody penetration into dense spinal cord tissue, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488/647 conjugates. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on robust immunostaining with stable synthetic fluorophores, which are fully compatible. Its organic solvent-based protocol ensures high transparency in lipid-rich white matter while preserving fine axonal morphology over 15 mm lengths.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord to reduce autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-β-III Tubulin (1:500) and anti-MBP (1:300) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.5%).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The original CUBIC protocol failed due to insufficient delipidation and poor penetration in dense adult mouse whole brain (~10 mm scale), leading to heterogeneous transparency and weak deep-tissue signal. iDISCO+ is an established, high-clearing-power solvent-based method for this exact tissue tier (T04_WHOLE_MOUSE_BRAIN_5_12MM), enabling deep antibody penetration and uniform transparency in large, lipid-rich samples. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, the problem statement permits only listed dyes/markers—thus, target-specific immediate early gene (IEG) markers C-FoS and Npas4 must be labeled via immunostaining with compatible Alexa Fluor dyes (488 and 647), which are explicitly validated for iDISCO+. This strategy ensures specific identification of two distinct activated neuron subpopulations while achieving whole-brain homogeneity required for single-cell 3D mapping and spatial clustering.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for adult brain autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking solution).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-C-FoS (e.g., Santa Cruz sc-52, 1:500) and anti-Npas4 (e.g., Synaptic Systems 247 003, 1:500) diluted in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

12 Storage / Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer brain to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Laminin (LAMA5)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D reconstruction of regenerating and spared axonal tracts across a 15-mm-long, lipid-rich spinal cord segment containing a dense glial scar at the injury epicenter. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for long CNS tissues (T06 tier) that provides strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and rapid clearing—critical for visualizing fine, continuous axonal processes through scar tissue. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so we use robust, covalently conjugated Alexa Fluor dyes: anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labels all neuronal axons (including regenerating fibers), while anti-Laminin highlights the extracellular matrix scaffold around blood vessels and lesion borders, enabling spatial correlation of axon trajectories relative to injury architecture. Both Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are fully compatible with iDISCO+.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for spinal cord autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-Laminin (LAMA5, 1:200).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in a glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: as needed for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-c-Fos + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Npas4 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires distinguishing two immediate early gene (IEG)-expressing neuronal subpopulations (c-Fos and Npas4) across the entire adult mouse brain. Both are nuclear IEG markers specific to functionally activated neurons, fulfilling target specificity. iDISCO+ is selected because it is established for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), provides strong delipidation for deep antibody penetration into dense tissue, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and 647—robust synthetic dyes that resist organic solvent quenching. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunostaining with compatible Alexa Fluor conjugates. Its relatively fast processing and high clearing efficacy outweigh mild tissue shrinkage concerns, which are acceptable for single-cell mapping when geometry is preserved sufficiently for registration.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Preparation  
1.1 Post-fixation of perfusion-fixed whole brain in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment removal)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization and Blocking  
5.1 Incubation with PBST containing 20% (vol/vol) DMSO and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Primary Antibody Staining  
6.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:500) and goat anti-Npas4 (1:250) diluted in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

7 Washing  
7.1 Wash with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 × 24 hours, change buffer daily)  

8 Secondary Antibody Staining  
8.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light)  

9 Post-staining Washes  
9.1 Wash with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 × 24 hours, change buffer daily, protected from light)  

10 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

11 Delipidation  
11.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  

12 Refractive Index Matching  
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  

13 Imaging Preparation  
13.1 Transfer cleared brain to a glass imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, DiI]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity visualization of long-range corticospinal projections within an intact ~40 mm CNS specimen, necessitating deep labeling penetration, strong lipid removal for transparency, and compatibility with far-red fluorophores for deep imaging. iDISCO+ is established for T06_LONG_CNS_OR_TUBULAR_15_80MM samples, provides excellent clearing power for dense neural tissue, enables deep antibody penetration via methanol dehydration and organic delipidation, and preserves Alexa Fluor 647 signal—ideal for light-sheet microscopy. Endogenous FPs are quenched in iDISCO+, so we avoid GFP/YFP and instead use a robust pan-axonal structural marker (anti–β-III Tubulin/TUJ1 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) to reveal the global axonal scaffold, combined with lipophilic tracer DiI injected pre-fixation (or applied post-fixation to cortical injection sites) to specifically label corticospinal projection neurons. This dual-labeling strategy allows discrimination of target-specific long-range fibers (DiI) from background axonal architecture (TUJ1-AF647), enabling precise tracing of projection continuity, branching, and termination across brain–spinal cord segments.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigments present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Permeabilization and Blocking  
3.1 Rehydration: sequential incubation in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each at RT.  
3.2 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Primary Antibody Staining (for β-III Tubulin)  
4.1 Incubation with anti–β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) primary antibody diluted 1:500 in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) BSA.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

5 Wash  
5.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day, with 4 buffer changes)  

6 Secondary Antibody Staining  
6.1 Incubation with donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:300 in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) BSA.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

7 Wash  
7.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day, with 4 buffer changes, protected from light)  

8 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

9 Delipidation  
9.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

11 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
11.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet microscopy, ensuring minimal mechanical stress on the fragile spinal cord.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate prior to imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647, MBP+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D visualization of long-range corticospinal projections across the entire CNS (≈40 mm), demanding a clearing method with strong delipidation power and deep antibody penetration. iDISCO+ is established for this tissue tier (T06_LONG_CNS_OR_TUBULAR_15_80MM), provides excellent clearing of dense neural tissue, and supports robust immunolabeling with far-red and green fluorophores. Endogenous FPs are not required; instead, we use two target-specific markers: β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) to label all neuronal axons (including corticospinal tract fibers) and MBP to label myelinated endogenous axon tracts, enabling spatial relationship analysis between projection fibers and host white matter. Alexa Fluor 647 and 488 are fully compatible with iDISCO+, resist quenching during organic solvent processing, and offer optimal spectral separation for dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for CNS pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) and anti-MBP (1:250).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) for TUJ1 and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500) for MBP.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, gentle agitation)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount directly in DBE-compatible imaging chamber for light-sheet microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, MBP + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of long-range corticospinal projections across a large (35–40 mm), lipid-rich CNS sample. iDISCO+ is established for this tissue tier (T06_LONG_CNS_OR_TUBULAR_15_80MM), provides strong delipidation for deep penetration, and enables robust antibody labeling in intact tissue. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes. We select β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) as a pan-neuronal axonal marker to trace all neuronal projections—including the target corticospinal tract—and myelin basic protein (MBP) to label white matter tracts, providing essential anatomical reference for assessing whether projections follow expected pathways and where they branch or overlap with endogenous myelinated fibers. This dual-labeling strategy fulfills the need for both target fiber visualization and structural context.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for CNS pigmentation)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6.2 Incubation with PTx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with PTx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with PTx + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), matching host species of primaries.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)

8.2 Incubation with PTx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with PTx.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D tracing of long-range corticospinal projections across a 35–40 mm intact CNS, demanding strong delipidation for deep penetration while preserving tissue geometry and fluorescence. Organic solvent-based methods offer superior clearing power for such large, lipid-rich samples. Among solvent methods established for T06_LONG_CNS_OR_TUBULAR_15_80MM, FDISCO is uniquely optimized to preserve exogenous fluorescent dyes (including Alexa Fluor conjugates) and minimize shrinkage compared to iDISCO+ or uDISCO, which cause severe morphological distortion in elongated neural tracts. Endogenous FPs are avoided per problem constraints; instead, pan-axonal β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) labeled with far-red Alexa Fluor 647 enables robust, continuous visualization of all axons—including the target projection—as a structural backbone, while vascular/perineuronal Lectin (compatible with FDISCO) labeled with Alexa Fluor 488 provides spatial reference landmarks without interfering with neuronal signal. This dual-labeling strategy ensures both specific long-range fiber tracking and contextual network mapping, with FDISCO’s controlled dehydration and RI matching preserving length and fluorescence intensity.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (critical for CNS pigment removal and uniform clearing)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for antibody/dye penetration)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Immunolabeling and Lectin Staining  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.02% (wt/vol) sodium azide).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibody mix: anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) + biotinylated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum, 1:200) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  
4.3 Washing with PBT (6 changes over 2 days).(Temperature: RT, Time: total 48 hours)  
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibody mix: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) + Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated streptavidin (1:500) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)  
4.5 Washing with PBT (6 changes over 2 days).(Temperature: RT, Time: total 48 hours)  

5 Dehydration (post-staining)  
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

6 Delipidation  
6.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.4 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite storage)  
8.2 Mount vertically in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet microscopy for whole-CNS 3D acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of amyloid-β (Aβ) plaques across the entire 5XFAD mouse brain, necessitating deep antibody penetration and strong lipid removal in a large, dense tissue sample. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), offering rapid, high-clearing power with excellent compatibility for Alexa Fluor–conjugated antibodies. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on immunostaining. We selected the well-validated anti-Aβ antibody 6E10 (targeting Aβ1–16) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 for specific plaque detection, and anti-NeuN (RBFOX3) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 as a pan-neuronal structural reference to enable accurate brain region segmentation, registration, and contextual analysis of plaque distribution. Both fluorophores are fully compatible with iDISCO+ chemistry, and the dual-channel strategy supports precise co-localization-free spatial mapping.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction in aged AD brain)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-6E10 (1:500) and anti-NeuN (1:300) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times (total 3 washes).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG1 Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times (total 3 washes).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store cleared brain immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in a glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 488, 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D mapping of Aβ plaques in intact 5XFAD mouse brains using two distinct but complementary anti-Aβ antibodies (6E10 and 4G8), which recognize different Aβ epitopes (residues 1–16 and 17–24, respectively). This dual-antibody strategy enables cross-validation of plaque detection, coverage, and regional burden. iDISCO+ is selected because it is established for whole adult mouse brains (~10 mm scale), provides strong delipidation for deep antibody penetration into dense amyloid-laden tissue, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647—both robust dyes that resist quenching during organic solvent processing. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous immunostaining. Its relatively fast protocol and high clearing efficacy outweigh mild tissue shrinkage concerns, especially when geometric fidelity is monitored via fiducial landmarks.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching (optional but recommended for AD brain with heme-rich microhemorrhages)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared by mixing 1 volume 30% H₂O₂ with 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT containing 20% (vol/vol) DMSO and 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS) + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 1% (wt/vol) BSA.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-6E10 (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) + anti-4G8 (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) diluted in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat washing step 6.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: goat anti-mouse IgG1 Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) + goat anti-mouse IgG2b Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), diluted in blocking solution (note: 6E10 is IgG1, 4G8 is IgG2b; use subclass-specific secondaries to minimize cross-reactivity).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat washing step 8.1 three more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store cleared brain immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in a glass capillary or imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate prior to imaging)

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** Ce3D is an aqueous-based clearing method established for dense adult mouse brain tissue blocks (5–12 mm), offering excellent preservation of tissue morphology with minimal shrinkage—critical for accurately assessing tumor boundaries and vascular continuity. Unlike CUBIC, which caused structural disintegration in GBM tissue, Ce3D provides strong yet gentle delipidation while maintaining protein epitopes and endogenous fluorescence compatibility. It supports deep antibody penetration required for thick GBM samples and is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI. CD31 labels all endothelial cells to map the full vascular network; Claudin-5 specifically marks tight junctions of the blood-brain barrier, enabling assessment of barrier integrity across tumor core, edge, and peritumoral regions. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for tumor cell localization without interfering with vascular analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (perform before clearing)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CD31 (1:200) and anti-Claudin-5 (1:100) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (5% NGS, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days with gentle agitation)  
1.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS): 3 changes over 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours per wash)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400) in antibody dilution buffer (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days with gentle agitation)  
1.5 Wash with PBST: 3 changes over 24 hours (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours per wash)  
1.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.7 Final wash with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Tissue Dehydration (Ce3D-compatible graded ethanol series)  
2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with Ce3D-A solution (25% (wt/vol) N-methylnicotinamide, 25% (wt/vol) urea, 15% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (vol/vol) glycerol in distilled water) (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days with gentle shaking)  
3.2 Wash with distilled water (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with Ce3D-B solution (50% (wt/vol) N-methylnicotinamide, 25% (wt/vol) urea, 30% (vol/vol) glycerol in distilled water) (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with fresh Ce3D-B solution (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with Ce3D-B solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at 4 ℃ for up to 2 weeks)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 488, 4G8 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method established for whole adult mouse brains (T04 tier), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for dense amyloid plaques in 5XFAD models. It provides high transparency with minimal residual autofluorescence, enabling reliable discrimination of true Aβ deposits from background. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as we use exogenous immunolabeling. Dual labeling with two well-validated anti-Aβ antibodies (6E10 targeting Aβ1–16 and 4G8 targeting Aβ17–24) conjugated to spectrally distinct, iDISCO+-compatible fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647) ensures cross-validated, specific detection of amyloid pathology, minimizing false positives from lipofuscin or non-specific granules. The method’s speed and compatibility with hydrophobic mounting media (e.g., DBE) support high-resolution light-sheet imaging of intact brains.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching (optional but recommended for AD brain to reduce heme/iron-related autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (prepared fresh: 1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: mouse anti-human Aβ 6E10 (1:500) and mouse anti-Aβ 4G8 (1:500) diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 three more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: goat anti-mouse IgG1 Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500, for 6E10) and goat anti-mouse IgG2b Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500, for 4G8), diluted in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Wash with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 three more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 2:1 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store cleared brain in 100% DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount in DBE-compatible glass capillary or chamber for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM).

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for adult mouse brain blocks (5–12 mm) with high lipid content and dense tumor tissue. It provides strong delipidation and deep penetration while preserving fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes—critical for visualizing both vascular lumen (via Lectin) and blood-brain barrier integrity (via Claudin-5). Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, Ce3D), FDISCO achieves faster and more complete clearing in glioblastoma-infiltrated brain, which is highly cellular and lipid-rich. Lectin labels perfused vasculature broadly and robustly in fixed tissue, while Claudin-5 specifically marks endothelial tight junctions to assess barrier disruption in tumor vs. normal regions. Both Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are fully compatible with FDISCO, as confirmed by method-fluorophore compatibility data.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion and Post-fixation Confirmation  
1.1 Confirm tissue has been transcardially perfused with ice-cold PBS followed by 4% (wt/vol) PFA in PBS, and post-fixed in 4% PFA at 4 ℃ for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling and Vascular Staining  
2.1 Wash tissue 3× with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
2.2 Incubate with blocking solution (PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubate with primary antibody against Claudin-5 (1:200 in blocking solution) and fluorescently conjugated Lectin (e.g., Isolectin B4 from Griffonia simplicifolia, 10 µg/mL in blocking solution). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)  
2.4 Wash thoroughly 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  
2.5 Incubate with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500 in blocking solution) if primary is rabbit-derived; omit if Claudin-5 antibody is directly conjugated. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
2.6 Wash 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubate with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubate with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubate with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubate with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubate with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.6 Repeat 100% methanol incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Bleaching (Optional, for endogenous pigment reduction)  
4.1 Incubate with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours in the dark)  
4.2 Wash 2× with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubate with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubate with 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubate with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.2 Transfer to fresh 100% ECi for final clearing and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours or until optically transparent)  

7 Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Mount cleared sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with fresh ECi. Seal to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or store at RT in dark for up to 1 week)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素)+Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D visualization of both the vascular lumen (to trace tumor invasion along vessels) and endothelial barrier integrity (via tight junctions). Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* or *Griffonia simplicifolia* isolectin B4) binds specifically to endothelial glycocalyx and labels perfusable vasculature with high signal-to-noise in thick tissue. Claudin-5 is a brain endothelial-specific tight junction protein critical for blood-brain barrier integrity; its disruption correlates with GBM invasion. iDISCO+ was selected because it provides strong delipidation and deep antibody/dye penetration in dense, fixed mouse brain blocks (~8 mm scale), which is essential for visualizing fine vascular networks across tumor core, invasive front, and normal parenchyma. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on exogenous Alexa Fluor-conjugated reagents, which are fully compatible. iDISCO+ also achieves high transparency rapidly with organic solvents, enabling efficient light-sheet imaging of large volumes while preserving vascular morphology better than uDISCO (less shrinkage than PEGASOS/uDISCO for soft brain tissue).

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Blocking  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  
1.8 Rehydration: sequential incubation with 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)  
1.9 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.10 Incubation with blocking solution: PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 5% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Primary and Secondary Labeling (Combined Direct Lectin + Anti-Claudin-5)  
2.1 Incubation with labeling cocktail: 10 µg/mL Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin (e.g., IB4 or tomato lectin) + 1:200 anti-Claudin-5 primary antibody (e.g., rabbit anti-mouse Claudin-5) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, gentle agitation)  
2.2 Wash with PBT (3 changes, 24 hours total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 1:500 Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated donkey anti-rabbit IgG secondary antibody in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle agitation)  
2.4 Wash with PBT (3 changes, 24 hours total).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation  
4.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)
